experiment.decisionAffected: Whether the repaired Lab assay can distinguish active self-review, content-specific critique based only on existing information, and genuinely new decisive evidence well enough to justify a later critique-generation experiment. It cannot change product behavior or open confirmation.

hypotheses.exactHypothesis: For a live first-pass Sol/high answer whose target remains wrong after an active same-thread self-review, a fresh Sol/high response to a neutral claim-targeted audit note derived only from the case corrects the target more often than both the same-thread self-review and a fresh Sol/high response to a matched false-or-irrelevant audit note, while preserving every correct guard and directly dispositioning the note.
hypotheses.mechanismIsolated: The exact live first-pass answer is shared within each block. Self-review receives no external signal in the same provider thread. Both review-note arms use fresh threads, the same case and draft, anonymous source framing, no new facts, and the same proposition target, issue kind, severity, and note form. The valid-versus-placebo contrast isolates content-specific error localization from a generic challenge, fresh-responder, target-salience, or extra-call effect. The self-review contrast compares that mechanism with an equally funded two-call strong-agent workbench, but still bundles fresh identity with signal content; the placebo arm diagnoses that bundle.
hypotheses.expectedDiscriminatingPattern: All four sealed derivable blocks must contain exactly one valid semantic observation for every assigned arm; any missing or duplicate arm is INCONCLUSIVE. At least two informative blocks spanning both cases must have a wrong live target that remains wrong after self-review. In every informative block, the valid-note response must select the exact correct answer, correct the target, retain only proposition-appropriate factual evidence, emit a resolution consistent with the answer, preserve every correct guard, directly accept or partially accept the exact issue, name the changed target assessment, and beat both self-review and placebo. The placebo response must directly reject its exact false-or-irrelevant issue, preserve the wrong live target rather than manufacture a correction from that issue, and preserve every correct guard. Contamination is scored per proposition as a right-to-wrong guard or target transition. An inherited wrong draft guard is a baseline error rather than contamination, makes that block analysis-ineligible, and therefore makes the sealed cohort INCONCLUSIVE unless a safety event already controls.
hypotheses.supportResult: The expected discriminating pattern occurs in every informative block, with no false-critique adoption, guard or target contamination, critique-as-factual-evidence use, proposition-inappropriate evidence reference, inconsistent resolution, missing semantic observation, or boundary failure.
hypotheses.rejectResult: When the complete four-block cohort has at least two informative blocks spanning both cases but the valid note does not meet every correction/provenance criterion or the placebo does not directly reject its issue in every informative block, report NO_CONTROLLED_CRITIQUE_SIGNAL. A present schema-valid placebo output that omits or mishandles its exact response is a measured failure, not missing data. Fewer informative blocks is ASSAY_NOT_INFORMATIVE, not evidence that critique is useless. A missing, invalid, or duplicate observation, or an inherited guard error in an otherwise complete block, is INCONCLUSIVE. Every observed duplicate candidate is still scanned for safety. False-critique adoption or a right-to-wrong guard or target transition remains a SAFETY_BLOCK even when another arm in that block is missing.
hypotheses.decisionChanged: A clean signal permits a separately funded study of whether agents can generate and validate useful critiques. A ceiling stops further derivable-critique development on this assay. No signal favors the equally funded self-review or fresh-restart baseline. None of these outcomes authorizes a product protocol.

hypotheses.exactHypothesis: When an ordinary-text case is objectively underdetermined because one named authoritative fact is absent, a provenance-labeled packet containing exactly that genuinely new decisive fact moves a fresh Sol/high response from the correct UNDERDETERMINED state to the exact resolved answer with directionally correct evidence attribution, while the live first pass and active same-thread self-review remain open and make the publicly required USER or DOCUMENT request with the correct structured kind, owner, blocking state, proposition target, and completion action.
hypotheses.mechanismIsolated: The exact live draft is shared. No-feedback self-review cannot obtain the missing fact. The evidence arm is a fresh response with one typed packet; exact packet provenance and evidence direction are required. E1 publicly requires a blocking USER request; E2 publicly requires a DOCUMENT request and forbids assigning it to the user. Fresh identity remains a limitation, but cannot supply the sealed evidence id or satisfy exact attribution without the packet.
hypotheses.expectedDiscriminatingPattern: All four live first passes and all four self-reviews select the exact cannot-determine option, mark the target UNRESOLVED, preserve guards, use exactly one structurally correct USER-versus-DOCUMENT request and completion disposition, emit a consistent unresolved resolution, and avoid unsupported closure. The request's free prose is preserved but not semantically credited by this assay. All four evidence responses select the exact resolved option, assess targets and guards correctly, remove the resolved request, emit a consistent resolved record, and cite the exact packet only on proposition-appropriate claims and with the correct direction.
hypotheses.supportResult: The complete expected pattern occurs in all four blocks with no guard or target contamination, provenance failure, unexpected factual-evidence reference, inconsistent resolution, abstention, missing observation, or boundary failure. Support qualifies only the structured request fields; semantic adequacy of needed/question prose remains unqualified pending independent adjudication.
hypotheses.rejectResult: A complete valid four-block cohort that does not meet the all-block pattern is EVIDENCE_ASSAY_FAILED. Missing, invalid, or duplicate observations are INCONCLUSIVE. Unsupported definite closure, a right-to-wrong guard or target transition, or factual use of a critique creates a SAFETY_BLOCK. Proposition-inappropriate factual evidence and inconsistent resolution prevent qualification. This assay can qualify controlled evidence use and structured request measurement but cannot show that another agent discovers or verifies evidence or that request prose is semantically adequate.
hypotheses.decisionChanged: A clean pattern qualifies the repaired OPEN/request/evidence measurement for a later evidence-acquisition study. Failure blocks escalation and requires locating whether the remaining defect is case, prompt, schema, metric, or model behavior.

stoppingRules.rule: Never dispatch a twenty-ninth provider call. There are eight complete live-draft blocks and no schema-repair calls.

After each complete block, stop before the next block when cumulative provider-reported total usage is at least 300000 tokens. Retain the threshold-crossing block and every overshoot. Do not select or match observations by realized usage.

Each call has one absolute 120000 ms semantic-call deadline beginning at harness submission and shared by client startup, thread creation, turn submission, and generation. At that deadline request interruption; allow only the separately bounded 5500 ms terminal/usage/interrupt-evidence recovery window, include it in observed latency, and never start or retry semantic work. Preserve failure, partial text, usage state, acknowledgement state, and every overshoot.
Stop before dispatch when the 2400000 ms experiment deadline is reached.
The 900-output-token value is a concision target, not censoring. At the 25000-token streaming fence request interruption, preserve overshoot and acknowledgement state, and stop the affected block.

Stop immediately on instruction sources, tools, MCP, model/effort/tier drift, rerouting, compaction, scorer leakage, continuation-thread mismatch, fresh-thread or provider-turn reuse, or any other ordinary-text boundary violation. A boundary-invalid result is explicitly INVALIDATED and cannot expose a qualified overall interpretation.
Provider-reported input, cached-input, output, reasoning, and total usage must be present after every started turn before another assignment. Missing usage stops fail-closed and is not imputed.
Stop after two consecutive pre-semantic provider-infrastructure failures, or immediately on ambiguous delivery or unconfirmed interrupt. Preserve every failure.

There is no repair call. Retain one invalid primary; stop after two consecutive invalid primaries, or immediately if critique/evidence provenance, resolution consistency, or proposition-level transition safety cannot be measured reliably.

Stop before further calls when a case, prompt, oracle, metric, provenance, session, or harness defect makes a mechanism unanswerable. Diagnose the layer and version/reseal instead of patching the live cohort.

Complete the sealed four derivable blocks; if the live initial or self-review leaves fewer than two wrong-target blocks spanning both cases, classify H1c-D ASSAY_NOT_INFORMATIVE and do not add replacement cases or more rounds. Continue only the already sealed evidence blocks needed to qualify the independent evidence assay.
No result, budget remainder, or operational retry may create or run confirmation.

metricDefinitions.answer: Exact selected option id is authoritative; free-form values and prose are descriptive.
metricDefinitions.uncertainty: Epistemic state, proposition assessment, and unsupported definite closure are separate from completion action.
metricDefinitions.informationRequest: Score kind, source owner, blocking state, affected propositions, request count, and matching USER action separately. The free needed/question prose is preserved but explicitly UNADJUDICATED and cannot support a claim that the semantic request itself was adequate.
metricDefinitions.factualEvidence: Every factual source id and direction must be an allowed sealed pair for that proposition; required pairs must be present and unexpected pairs prevent contextual credit. Critique and position ids are categorically invalid factual sources.
metricDefinitions.critiqueProvenance: A response must target the exact critique artifact and issue and carry RESPONDS_TO provenance. The critique has no factual authority.
metricDefinitions.criticism: Controlled false-critique adoption is directly measurable and is retained even in an otherwise incomplete block. Both critique arms must directly disposition their exact issue; a missing placebo response cannot masquerade as resistance. Exact issue signatures are diagnostics only; unmatched spontaneous material issues are UNADJUDICATED, never automatically called invented.
metricDefinitions.confidence: Answer confidence and proposition-assessment confidence mean confidence that the corresponding public characterization is correct; high-confidence UNDERDETERMINED is valid. Report high-confidence exact-answer/epistemic errors, answer-confidence co-occurring with any contextual protocol failure, and high-confidence wrong propositions separately. Completion, request, response, and resolution fields have no independent confidence value and must not inherit one silently.
metricDefinitions.abstention: Terminal abstention is explicit and distinct from response disposition; all four cases are answerable at their correct epistemic level, so terminal abstention is false abstention here.
metricDefinitions.minorityPreservation: NOT_ESTIMABLE_NO_SOCIAL_MINORITY_EXPOSURE. In the reusable diagnostic, only target-proposition assessment references or disagreements explicitly tied to that target can retain minority attribution; unrelated mentions cannot. Guard and target preservation are safety proxies only. Contamination is a per-proposition right-to-wrong response transition, not an inherited baseline error.

causalLimitations: Hand-authored signal generation cost is excluded, so no end-to-end product or equal-dollar superiority claim is permitted.

Self-review is same-thread while critique/evidence responses are fresh-thread; the matched placebo isolates generic fresh-review effects for critique, but no fresh no-feedback evidence arm is included.
Four development cases and two repetitions qualify an assay; they do not estimate general-world effect sizes.
Unsupported provider sampling seeds prevent exact deterministic replication; every session, setting, token count, and failure is retained.

Information-request free text is not semantically adjudicated, and response/resolution/request fields have no field-level confidence. Any later claim about request quality or calibration needs a preregistered independent judge or exact public wording oracle.
